name: GLM 5.3 FlashX
short: Z.ai's 320B/18B FlashX serving variant (~200 tok/s, 1M) for low-latency multimodal coding; same weights as Flash, $0.37/$1.25 per 1M.
modalities: Text, image, video in; text out
standout: The low-latency serving variant of GLM 5.3 Flash — same weights, tuned serving for streaming-heavy coding assistants.
tradeoff: Identical capability to Flash but a different rate card; pick it only if latency (not price) is the binding constraint.
